title: EastRising ER-TFT1.28-1 TFT LCD Display Datasheet, REV 1.0 (Dec-02-2019), outline drawing dated Feb-07-2025
note: Read as text through the Protoboard fetch service; a direct download returns HTTP 403 (Cloudflare challenge) here. The drawing's dimension strings come through the text extraction only, so geometry was read from the archived 2019 drawing (src_datasheet_2019) and checked against these strings.
supports: 1.1 order number: ER-TFT1.28-1, no touch panel
2.1: 240xRGBx240, FPC connector 'Hollow out FPC', operating -20..+70 C, storage -30..+80 C
2.2: outline with FPC folded 35.60 (W) x 37.80 (H) x 1.5 (T) mm, visual area 33.4 mm, active area 32.4 mm, dot pitch 0.135 mm
2.3: COG, GC9A01 controller, 4-wire serial SPI
2.4: IPS, 400 cd/m2 typ, contrast 500:1
4.1 pin configuration (12 pins)
4.2 absolute maximum: supplies -0.3..+4.6 V, logic input -0.3..VDD+0.3 V
4.3 electrical: VDD 2.5/2.8/3.3 V, VIH 0.7 VDD, VIL 0.3 VDD, IDD 8.5 typ 10.5 max mA, sleep-in 15 typ 30 max uA
4.4 backlight: 2-chip LED, Vf 2.9/3.0/3.1 V at 30 mA, If 30 typ 40 max mA, 30000 h
6.1-6.2 power precautions: VDD must also supply every device that drives the bus
7.5 soldering: 280 +-10 C, 3-4 s
7.5: remove flux residue after soldering, except with non-halogen flux

title: EastRising ER-TFT1.28-1 datasheet, REV 1.0, drawing dated Dec-02-2019 (Internet Archive capture of 2023-01-28)
note: Earlier issue of the same document, read as a rendered drawing. Same pin table and electrical tables as src_datasheet; outline height 38.10 (BL) where the 2025 drawing gives 37.8 (LCM).
supports: 3.1 drawing (rendered): backlight 35.60 x 38.10, LCD glass 35.2 x 37.24, polarizer 34.74 x 34.32, active area 32.40 offset 1.60 from the backlight edges, thickness 1.50 +-0.1, FPC 0.13 +-0.03 thick

3.1 drawing: FPC tail 11.4 +-0.2 wide, 12 contacts 0.35 wide at 0.7 pitch (7.7 span) in a window at the tail end, 2.00 long in the front view and 1.70 in the rear view; 2 x dia 1.0 +-0.05 holes 10.00 apart, the pin-12 hole centre 1.00 in from the pin-12 side edge of the tail (a sideways dimension; nothing places the holes along the tail)

3.1 drawing scaled at 1200 dpi (marked not to scale; 50.0 px/mm along the tail, 45.6 px/mm across): hole centres about 4.0 from the tail end (2.0 beyond the window); tail pad about 10.0 long and about 0.9 wider than 11.4 on the pin-1 side at the hole end. Used only for assumption traits
3.1 drawing: unfolded tail end 12.24 +-0.3 beyond the backlight edge; folded tail end 10.24 +-0.5 in from the outer edge; fold protrudes 0.50 max beyond the backlight frame
3.1 drawing: pin 1 nearest the +y alignment hole in the front view; LED schematic: 2 LEDs in parallel between A and K, If = 40 mA, Vf = 2.9-3.1 V
4.1-4.4: same pin table, ratings and backlight table as src_datasheet
3.1 fold note: the FPC fold stands out of the backlight frame; backlight lead region H = 0.45 max; leave clearance in the housing
